title: What Parents in China See in A.I. Toys
summary: A video of a child crying over her broken A.I. chatbot stirred up conversation in China, with some viewers questioning whether the gadgets are good for children. But the girl’s father says it’s more than a toy; it’s a family member.

title: Why Russia Is Likely to Reject the New US-Ukrainian Peace Plan
summary: The first draft essentially called for Ukraine’s surrender. The revised version includes the security guarantees Kyiv wants to prevent future Russian aggression.

title: Tech groups shift $120bn of AI data centre debt off balance sheets
summary: Creative financing helps insulate Big Tech while binding Wall Street to a future boom or bust
